sourceCoverage.coverageNote: The current review covers Jeffco's official calendar page and the district-published 2026–27 and 2027–28 English family calendar PDFs. Jeffco also publishes Spanish, Vietnamese and Russian translations for both reviewed years.

contentFreshnessScore.refreshRule: Recheck the Jeffco calendar page when a family calendar PDF is replaced, a potential snow make-up day is activated, translated calendars change or another future-year calendar is published.

districtFact: Jeffco's family calendars separate student contact days from teacher workdays, identify staff-development dates that may become snow make-up days and direct families to individual schools for additional modified contact days.

about.title: One district calendar, with school-level additions
about.content: The Jeffco District Family Calendar is the starting point for first and last days, breaks, legal holidays, teacher staff development and potential snow make-up days. It is not a complete building calendar: Jeffco says additional modified contact days appear on individual school calendars.

about.title: Snow make-up dates remain conditional
about.content: Jeffco prints potential snow make-up dates on days otherwise assigned to teacher staff development. Those dates are not guaranteed student holidays. Each reviewed year page keeps them visible as conditional dates and excludes them from the one-time ICS import.

about.title: Last-day rules can differ by year and school type
about.content: The 2026–27 PDF says district-run PK–12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours early on the last day and explicitly tells charter families to contact their school. The 2027–28 PDF does not repeat that early-dismissal notice, so this site does not carry the rule forward automatically.

calendarNotes: Use the district family calendar for Jeffco-wide dates, then check the student's school calendar for additional modified contact days and building events. Potential snow make-up dates can change from staff-development days to student attendance days. The 2026–27 last-day early-dismissal notice applies to district-run PK–12 schools and excludes charter schools; the 2027–28 PDF does not publish the same notice. Spanish, Vietnamese and Russian PDFs are translations of the same family calendar, not separate attendance tracks. MySchoolDates ICS files are one-time imports and do not update automatically.

planningTips.title: Using the Jeffco family calendar
content: Keep potential snow make-up dates flexible until Jeffco confirms whether students must attend.
Check the individual school calendar for modified contact days, bell schedules, conferences, testing and building events that do not appear in the district PDF.
For 2026–27, district-run PK–12 schools dismiss 2.5 hours early on May 27; charter families need the dismissal information published by their school.
Use the translated PDF for the family's preferred language, but treat it as a translation of the English district calendar rather than a separate schedule.

districtFaqs.q: What is a Jeffco student contact day?
districtFaqs.a: A student contact day is a day counted in Jeffco's published student calendar. Both reviewed PDFs list 171 student contact days: 79 in the first semester and 92 in the second.

districtFaqs.q: Why does Jeffco list 185 teacher workdays but 171 student contact days?
districtFaqs.a: Teacher workdays include staff-development dates before, during and after the student calendar. Students do not attend every teacher workday, which is why the totals differ.

districtFaqs.q: Are Jeffco snow make-up dates guaranteed days off?
districtFaqs.a: No. Jeffco labels them as potential snow make-up days and also lists them as teacher staff development. The district may use them for student attendance if instructional time must be recovered.

districtFaqs.q: Does the Jeffco family calendar include every no-school date?
districtFaqs.a: No. The district PDF says additional modified contact days are identified on individual school calendars. Families should check both the district family calendar and their school's calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Do Jeffco charter schools always follow the district family calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Families should verify dates and dismissal times with the charter school. Jeffco's 2026–27 last-day notice explicitly excludes charter schools, and school-level schedules may differ from the district family calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Are Jeffco's Spanish, Vietnamese and Russian calendars different schedules?
districtFaqs.a: No. They are official translations of the same district family calendar for the school year.

customSections.label: Which Jeffco Calendar Should Families Use?
customSections.content: Jeffco publishes different calendar sources because the district PDF cannot answer every school-level planning question.
